evidence_items.explanation: A workplace study of a rollout in late 2020 and early 2021 found substantial measured gains in chats handled per hour. It challenges a literal reading covering every productivity statistic, but its single-firm scope cannot establish aggregate effects.

unresolved_gaps: The Danish study does not establish the magnitude of labor-market effects worldwide.
The representative U.S. time-savings estimate is not an observed causal estimate of aggregate productivity.
